sourceOfTruth: Baseline set: docs/generated-knowledge-coverage.json records.regions with shared-decorative-fallback at audit start; current integration statuses are synced to generated coverage.
sourcePolicy: A region is marked verified only when a Wikimedia Commons file page supplies explicit author and reusable license metadata, its title/description/categories support the exact catalog region, and a landscape preview is inspected. Other records remain needs-source; not-yet-audited is not a claim that no source exists.
